hypothesis: The observed nested OCI blocker may be specific to the default Amazon Linux 2023 Sandbox image/repositories rather than a fundamental Vercel Sandbox virtualization limitation.
counterhypothesis: Even in Vercel's supported Ubuntu Sandbox image, Podman/Buildah may fail to install or may fail `info` because required namespaces, storage drivers, mounts or kernel capabilities are unavailable.
primary_platform_basis: Vercel's Sandbox image documentation explicitly supports Sandbox.create with image='vercel/sandbox/ubuntu' and image-bound Sandboxes; this is an architecture candidate, not executable evidence.

preflight_contract.initial_network_policy: allow-all only for apt package provisioning

falsifier: Reject this path if the exact provider-admitted run cannot provision both tools, either tool's info command fails under the admitted Sandbox environment, deny-all recheck breaks the toolchain, or the sandbox cannot be cleanly stopped.

coordination.duplicate_candidate_search: No existing repository match for vercel/sandbox/ubuntu plus podman/buildah preflight was found before creating the candidate.
coordination.default_amazon_linux_path: Already observed blocked on missing podman/buildah packages; not repeated.
coordination.vcr_pinned_cli_retry: Also provider-rate-limited before deployment; no further identical retry is justified in this go.

next_executable_step: When Vercel provider admission materially changes, run this exact head once. If PASS_UBUNTU_OCI_TOOLCHAIN_PREFLIGHT is observed with exact source identity and sandbox stop evidence, promote the path only to a ClayVerse OCI build discriminator inside an exact Vercel Sandbox; do not infer whole-product acceptance. If it fails, preserve the negative result and reject the Ubuntu nested-OCI mechanism.
